description:
A casual remark has me on the path to becoming an actual bride?! 

A secluded dragon pond, avoided by all but known to house the dragon-in-waiting, Gangcheol. While the villagers steer clear in unease, for Iju, it’s the one place of true peace. 

“If it came to it, I’d rather be Gangcheol’s bride.” 

She muttered this thought in exhaustion, fed up with her family’s harsh treatment, thinking nothing of it. Yet, at that moment, a man appeared before her, exuding an aura as intense as the pond’s mystical light. 

“Then, how about becoming my real bride?”
